en: A sepia-toned image showing a forested or rural setting with a large, old building (perhaps a mill or country house) beside a pond or a small stream. Three people, probably children, are standing on the grassy bank near the water. Trees dominate the scene, making the building partially hidden. The image has the appearance of an early-20th-century photograph, with no visible modern elements.
